parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The username. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: UserNames
parameters.description: The usernames. Number of elements in the array: 0 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr list-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --next-token DD6B1B2A-5837-5237-ABE4-FF0C89568980 --max-results 20 --user-name test --user-names xi --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun emr ListUsers --region cn-hangzhou --UserName test --NextToken 'DD6B1B2A-5837-5237-ABE4-FF0C89568980' --ClusterId 'c-b933c5aac8fe0000' --MaxResults 20 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --UserNames.1 xi --method POST --force
